description: Section structure for a feature document in docs/feat/. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/feat.md section 4; this file is its machine-checkable half. It states what every feature document carries whatever its type: Summary, Table of Contents and Key Concepts open it, the optional sections keep their relative order, sections the document invents for itself follow them, and References closes it. A rule that depends on the document's type lives in the feat.<type>.structure.json layer beside this file, never as a condition here.
